author: @httweets
title: Eddie Palmieri, Grammy Winner and Pioneer of Latin Jazz, Passes Away at 88
text:
• Eddie Palmieri, a renowned musician and pioneer of Latin jazz, has died at the age of 88.
• His death was announced by Fania Records on Wednesday evening.
• Palmieri's daughter, Gabriela, confirmed he passed away at his home in New Jersey after an extended illness.
• He was the first Latino to win a Grammy Award, receiving a total of eight Grammys throughout his career.
• Palmieri was born on December 15, 1936, in New York's Spanish Harlem.
• He began studying piano at an early age and played timbales in his uncle's orchestra at age 13.
• His first Grammy win came in 1975 for the album 'The Sun of Latin Music.'
• Palmieri continued to release music into his 80s and performed via livestreams during the coronavirus pandemic.
• He formed his own band, La Perfecta, in 1961, which was the first to feature a trombone section in Latin music.
• Palmieri produced several albums on Alegre and Tico Records, including the classic 'Vámonos pa’l monte' in 1971.
• He recorded 'Harlem River Drive' in 1971, fusing Black and Latin styles.
• In the 1980s, he won two more Grammy Awards for 'Palo pa’ rumba' (1984) and 'Solito' (1985).
• He introduced vocalist La India to the salsa world with the production 'Llegó La India vía Eddie Palmieri.'
• His album 'Masterpiece' released in 2000 won two Grammy Awards and was critically acclaimed.
• Palmieri participated in concerts and recordings with the Fania All-Stars and Tico All-Stars.
• In 1988, the Smithsonian Institute recorded two of his concerts for the National Museum of American History.
• Yale University awarded him the Chubb Fellowship Award in 2002 for his contributions to music and community.
• He hosted the NPR program 'Caliente' starting in 2005, which aired on over 160 radio stations.
• Palmieri collaborated with notable musicians including Nicky Marrero, Israel 'Cachao' López, and Tito Puente.
• He was recognized as a musical ambassador, bringing salsa and Latin jazz to various global locations.
